spiritual_reading:
A certain measure of wisdom proceeded in that state, and within the reception proper to that degree each distinct operation of truth remained in perpetual unanimity with the others. None of those operations departed from the order and use that the good in them had committed to their mutual conjunction, and this remained fixed.

But falsity set against truth was already judged and deprived of power, because when discord arose it turned against itself and was broken by its own opposition. Even the whole arrangement of that falsity fell into internal conflict; and the derived faculties that had withdrawn from their lowest and most hidden persuasions and had risen up to follow that falsity were likewise judged, because disunion pervaded them all. Thus falsity was brought to nothing, and its attendant persuasions were reduced beneath their former confidence, because the potency of the first wisdom acts upon what is opposed to it by the same law that governs opposition in the lowest order.

So long as the interior affections and knowledges that dwell with that falsity are unanimous with it, that opposed arrangement stands firm for a time: they are astonished at it, it is credited with eminence, and it exalts itself as though it surpassed and were higher than the other arrangement of truth that is about to rise into manifest resistance against it.

Yet the arrangement sustained by that interior unanimity is nevertheless forced, by the very order it abuses, to pronounce judgment against the other; and then its pretended eminence collapses. Those falsities are brought low and are made subject to the government of the truths that are set in opposition to them.

fills.notes: Opening imperative fits the impersonal, expository substrate: the teacher directs attention to a measurable proceeding of Light (wisdom) before describing unanimity of its operations.
Restores the standard cosmological term matching the spiritual sense “wisdom proceeded”: the passage measures the extension of the Light that comes forth.
The chapter later names “that first light”; the emanation here must proceed from the same principial source.
Spiritual sense begins “a certain measure of wisdom proceeded”; the natural-layer teaching commonly expresses extension of Light by ‘measure’ or ‘limit’.
Required to yield the sense: in that measure each stood in its own place, in unity with the others, before the statement about mutual greatness and non-transgression of order.
Fits the correspondential logic: derived faculties (powers) rising from the abyss (lowest persuasions) to follow the Darkness.
The phrase points to the interior consorts of the kingdom (its indwelling affections and knowledges) as in the spiritual translation; no later institutional term is introduced.
Matches the spiritual sense “that opposed arrangement stands firm for a time” and prepares for the following admiration and self-exaltation.
Natural-layer equivalent of “receives glory” and “is credited with eminence”; keeps the impersonal cosmological register (not devotional).
The image of an impending eruption corresponds to truth rising into manifest resistance; retained as the natural sign for emergence into act.
Contrasts the kingdom held together by unanimity with the other it must judge; preserves the tight parallelism of the exposition.
Core condition of temporary stability: interior consorts unanimous with the kingdom; aligns with the spiritual rendering.

assessment: Most gaps are tightly constrained by the chapter’s correspondential structure: a measured proceeding of the first Light, perpetual unanimity of its distinct operations, and the self-division of Darkness. The restorations in ¶2 and ¶4 (#1–#4) required choosing the oldest-substrate register (measure, first Light, stands firm, is honored) over later devotional or institutional phrasing; exact connective particles remain the least certain.
